name: [💥] Aura Battles
desc:
💥 Battle other players using your own combination of powerful abilities and auras!

⚡ Land hits to earn Points and unlock 35+ abilities.  
✨ Open crates to collect 40+ auras that change the way you fight.  
🧪 Create over 1,000 possible combos and find the build that fits your playstyle.

👍 CURRENT CODE: LIKES180K  
🎁 NEXT CODE AT 190K LIKES!

📢 Join the communications server for codes, updates, and bug reports.

💎 PREMIUM BENEFIT: Earn 1.5x Gems in the AFK Chamber!

⚠️ Aura Battles is in beta. Expect new content, balance changes, and improvements as the game grows.

💻 PC: M1 Attack • Q Dash • E Ability • F Aura • Shift Camera Lock  
🎮 Controller: RT/R2 Attack • B/Circle Dash • X/Square Ability • Y/Triangle Aura

Inspired by Slap Battles, Ability Wars, Tongue Battles, and Sol’s RNG.
